questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne længere væk fra Danmark, for at udnytte at jeg havde et halvt år til at udforske landet, og så var det et plus at det er engelsk-talende.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Nogenlunde, UNSW har en mail som sender bolig-mails ud, men de begyndte først for alvor 2 uger før afrejse, og der ville jeg helst geren være sikret en bolig. De har en masse klubber som man først får info om i starten af et "rigtigt term". Winther term er altså uden social clubs og events.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var en informations dag ugen før term begyndte. Derudover er de gode til at sende mails om info. Jeg ville også råde til at kontakte andre fra DK eller KU, der skal til samme universitet. Det hjalp en del.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det er nemt at finde endten gennem Airbnb eller flatmates. Scape, unilodge og Iglu har en masse men det er endnu dyrere.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er MEGET dyrt at bo i Sydney. Det bliver nemt 10.000 kr om månden og så skal man passe på facebook scams. Jeg vil råde til at ansøge UNSW-village og andre on-campus kollegier som er billigere i god tid før afrejse. Man kan evt. booke Airbnb eller hostels de første par uger og så finde noget, mens man er der, hvilket er meget nemmere.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det ligner meget ansøgelses processen til udvekslingsophold. Det er en ekstern server, så det tager lidt tid at komme ind på den, men så virker den fint. Man skal bare være obs. på deadlines.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Jeg tror man kan både ringe og skrive til universitet, men selve registreringen var meget lige ud og beskrevet godt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle mine fag. Der var dog en jeg blev frameldt igen, fordi jeg glemte at betale for et class-trip. Jeg blev dog hjulpet til at vælge et andet fag og det var ret nemt at skifte.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Husk at tjekke jeres Uni-mails. Vær forberedt på at fag kan clash, hvilket man først finder ud af tæt på term start, men der kan man også få hjælp af studievejledere.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det var spændende men niveauet er en del lavere i de fag jeg valgte ift. KU.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg ville sige, at det faglige niveau generelt er lavere end på KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer:
De har ingen bøger man skal købe, så pensum er kun i forelæsningerne, turtorials, lab eller materiale de sender ud. Det er meget varierende undervisning, men nemt at forstå både undevisere og slides. Og så blev næsten alle mine forelæsninger optaget så man kan gense dem.
Eksamen tæller kun for en del af din endelige karakter. Du får point for opgaver og tests gennem semesteret. Jeg bestod alle mine fag før eksamen.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Jeg tog:
MSCI0501 The Marine Environment, 7.5 ECTS (Winther term)
BINF2010 Introduction to Bioinformatics, 7.5 ECTS (Term 3)
MATH1031 Mathematics for Life Sciences, 7.5 ECTS (Term 3)
MUSC2706 MUSIC ENSEMBLE, 7.5 ECTS (Term 3)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Heeelt klart musik faget. Faldt over det ved et tilfælde, da jeg havde tilmeldt mig kor for sjov i min fritid og fandt derefter ud af, at jeg kunne få credit for det, hvis jeg også tilmeldte mig et Handbell ensemble, hvilket også var mega sjovt og en kæmpe oplevelse. Intet af det kræver særlig musikkunnen, men man skal gerne kunne læse noder.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Kun at bolig var så dyrt også koster australsk student visa næsten 7k.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: UNSW har foodhub, hvor man kan få gratis madvarer, hvilket gjorde at jeg kunne spare en del på madbudget. Der er også mange events med gratis frokost osv. Generelt var mad billigere end i DK.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er mega mange fede social clubs, så det handler bare om at holde sig opdateret på events.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
alt.
https://www.arc.unsw.edu.au/clubs/find-a-club

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
SURF!!, både surfevents fra unsw surfclub og book timer eller lej/køb board jeg købte på facebook marketplace.
Løbeklub, Latin dance, yoga, pilates, reformer (class pass (appen)). 
CMC choir
Svøm, BBQ og spil beachvolly på ved strandende.
Coastal walks og hikes.
Sydney er generel en meget fysisk aktiv by.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Blue Mountains, Royal forrest, Natur reservater og dyresactuarys, Manly, Jerveys Bay, Melbourne, Brisbane, Tasmanien.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. De er meget mere åbne og imødkommende end i KBH. Jeg havde problemer med jetlag men man kan købe melatonin på alle apoteker.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Join klubberne. De lokale gider normalt ikke de sociale events UNSW arangerer.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ikke noget, borset fra at de kører i venstre side og ikke tager hensyn til cykler og fodgængere.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: De er sååå venlige og meget laidback. Det var også meget motiverende, hvor sporty de var. Sociaties er guld værd som en udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Husk udveksling er for oplevelser du skal nok komme igennem examinerne. 
2. Join klubber
3. Hver ikke bange for hajer og jellyfish, jeg så ikke en eneste og jeg var meget i vandet.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Husk solcreme

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Surf og venner (fik mest europæriske venner, men så er det nemmere at mødes igen her)

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Boligomkostninger og tidforskel til DK, det var lidt svært at ringe hjem.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
